verdict.rationale: The Batch API lets you send asynchronous groups of requests in bulk, with 50% lower costs, a separate pool of higher rate limits and a 24-hour turnaround. Batch is listed as a flagship capability, and pricing has a dedicated batch section. That delivers bulk operations across many items at once. Missing for 10: detailed docs on batch mechanics (input file format, status tracking, partial-failure handling), real-time bulk operations faster than 24-hour turnaround, and independent hands-on corroboration of batch use.
